unsupported: Founded by Kenneth Lynch and now in its third generation of family ownership, the business began as a workshop dedicated to classical European design traditions.

The firm manufactures three distinct product lines: Florentine Classics offers classically designed garden furniture handcrafted in metal and stone; Lynch Estate Elements supplies traditional garden ornament including statuary, planters, urns, sundials, and fountains; Lynch Urban Seating produces iconic benches and site furnishings installed in Central Park and other prominent parks nationwide.

The company serves the luxury residential market — penthouse terraces, verandas, and private gardens — as well as public institutions and landscape architects specifying site furnishings for parks and estates.
Notable installations include benches in New York’s Central Park, with additional projects at fine parks and estates across the country.
